evidence: Contract location: 8 files in packages/domain/src/games/; barrel exports public API; route handler imports from @reading-advantage/domain/games.
calculateGameXP formula verified: base=correctAnswers; bonus=(accuracy===1?2:0)+(victory?1:0)+(duration<60000?1:0); return Math.min(10,base+bonus).

recordGameCompletion calls assertCan(user,'games:complete',tenant), re-validates input, computes XP, SELECTs xpLogs by (userId, activityId) where activityId=game:<gameType>:<idempotencyKey>, returns duplicate:true with xpEarned:0 on retry.
completeRoute.ts POST validates body via safeParse, returns 400 on failure, returns {xpEarned, activityId, duplicate:false, status:200} on success. No db call.
